name: toon-formatter
title: TOON Formatter
description: Formats a JSON file into the TOON structure — a compact, LLM-friendly format that saves tokens, improves parsing consistency, and reduces hallucination surface. If the JSON is stringified, it will be parsed automatically before converting to TOON.
author: omaralex24

commands.name: convert-clipboard-json-to-toon
commands.title: Convert Clipboard JSON to TOON
commands.subtitle: Convert clipboard JSON into TOON
commands.description: Converts a JSON/JS object stored in the clipboard into TOON format and copies/pastes it back.

commands.name: convert-selected-json-to-toon
commands.title: Convert Selected JSON to TOON
commands.subtitle: Convert selected text into TOON
commands.description: Converts a JSON/JS Object selected in the foremost editor into TOON format and replaces it inline.

commands.name: convert-selected-show
commands.title: Convert Selected JSON and Show
commands.subtitle: Preview selected text as TOON
commands.description: Converts the selected JSON into TOON and shows a preview to copy.

commands.name: convert-json-to-toon
commands.title: Convert JSON to TOON
commands.subtitle: Convert JSON text into TOON in a form
commands.description: Converts a JSON/JS Object selected in the foremost editor into TOON format and replaces it inline.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
